Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.model.match

Class Match.Builder

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.model.match.Match.Builder
Enclosing class:
Match
public static class Match.Builder extends Object
Builder class for constructing Match instances with a fluent API. Supports creating matches from SikuliX matches, regions, images, and metadata.
